g.title: Part1v2
g.text: Three producers, one webhook-shaped ingress for push, per-agent inboxes. thread_id is a lock, not a queue.

g.title: cluster_producers
g.text: (three kinds, all build the same Event shape)

g.title: cluster_inboxes
g.text: (one queue per registered agent — created at startup from `agents` table)

g.title: adapters
g.text: each adapter holds its weird socket,

g.title: pull
g.text: emit Event only for new items

g.title: legend
g.text: 1. All push goes through ONE ingress: POST /events.
Adapters absorb IDLE / socket / streaming weirdness.
thread_id is a LOCK inside the invoker, not a queue key.
3. Cron + pull are in-process. No HTTP self-call.
